description: The line plot illustrates the training loss over steps for five different models—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBERTa Small 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—trained on a dataset of 20 million samples. The x-axis represents the training step, ranging from 0k to 440k, with major tick marks at intervals of 20k. The y-axis shows the training loss, scaled from 0.0 to 0.85, with gridlines at 0.2 intervals. All models begin with a high training loss near 0.8, which rapidly decreases within the first 20k steps. After this initial drop, the loss continues to decline more gradually, stabilizing around 0.15 by 40k steps. The ChemBERTa Small 20M (green) and ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple) models exhibit the lowest loss values, with the ChemBERTa Small 20M line consistently below the ChemLLaMA Small 20M line. The ChemBART Small 20M (red) and ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange) models show similar performance, with the ChemBERTa Medium 20M line slightly below the ChemBART Small 20M line. The ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown) model has the highest loss among the five, with its line positioned above the others throughout the training process. The plot includes a zoomed-in section from 400k to 440k steps, highlighting the final convergence of all models to a loss value near 0.1.
